propositions: the review-bot container environment lacks AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, causing boto3.session.Session().region_name to be None and bedrock-runtime client construction to raise NoRegionError
build_bedrock_provider passes region=None when REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION is unset, forcing fallback to boto3 ambient resolution which finds no region, resulting in hard failure before model invocation
the review-bot service provides no fallback when Bedrock client construction fails, downing the LLM-Review gate entirely for every landing instead of degrading gracefully
prior Bedrock probes in the epic passed region_name explicitly, masking the ambient resolution defect and leaving it undetected through verification
boto3 on this botocore version (1.43.58) resolves region only via AWS_DEFAULT_REGION env var and config files, not AWS_REGION or IMDS, making IMDS reachability orthogonal to the region problem
build_bedrock_provider must pre-check boto3 region resolution and raise a typed LLMConfigError naming REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION instead of surfacing an unactionable pydantic_ai UserError
